description: Abandoned Compound & Uncommercialized Trial Miner — Finds shelved drug and biologic candidates worth a second look. Give a disease or target (mines ClinicalTrials.gov for terminated, withdrawn and suspended trials and for completed Phase 1/2 non-industry trials with no later industry Phase 2/3/4 trial), a compound you already have in mind (drug name or ChEMBL id), a trial (NCT id), or a desired material property (literature mode, no trials). Every

biologicalTargetOrCondition.description: Disease, condition or biological target (e.g. "amyotrophic lateral sclerosis", "BACE1"). Mines stopped and completed-without-follow-up clinical trials.

compound.description: A compound you already have in mind, as a drug name or ChEMBL id (e.g. "edaravone", "CHEMBL290916"). Returns whether it is an abandoned, safe-to-pursue candidate or why it was excluded (marketed, safety signal, active development). Replaces the condition search.

includeCompletedNoFollowUp.description: Include completed Phase 1/2 non-industry trials with no later industry Phase 2/3/4 trial of the same intervention. Default true.

materialProperty.description: Desired material property (e.g. "high ionic conductivity solid electrolyte"). Mines the literature indexes; no trials are involved.

maxCandidates.description: Dossiers to produce (default 4, max 8). Model cost is at most one fast call per candidate.

nctId.description: A ClinicalTrials.gov trial id (e.g. "NCT01257048"). The compound it tested is reviewed as with `compound`.

name: abandoned-compound-miner
